sentences.text: 1  are seeking pre-arrest bail in C.R. No. I - 284 of 2019 re  with Bhiwandi Police Station, Thane for the ofences punish  under Sections 188, 328, 272, 273, 224 r/w 34 of Indian Pe  Code and 59, 26(2), 27 of the Food Safety and Standards Ac  2006.

It is alleged by frst informant Shankar Kishan   Food Safety Ofcer that on receipt of confdential informati  regarding sale of banned food products, he visited M/s.New  Bombay Supari Kirana and General Stores.

Applicant No. 1 informed the concerned ofcer that owner of the shop is Faiyyaz Ahmad Newaz Ahmad Shaikh i.e. Applicant No.2 and he was not present in the shop on that date.
No banned food products was found in the shop.

However, when the godown of the frst foor was checked,
banned products in the nature of pan masala, tobacco, gutka total valuing Rs. 2,37,074/- was found.
2. It is the contention of the learned Counsel for the Applicant No.1 that he is a student and was only present in the shop on that day as his brother - Applicant No.2 was not in town.
Applicant No.1 has no concern with the business.
Applicant No.2 is the owner of the shop.
This Court by interim order dated 21/11/2019 granted interim pre-arrest bail.
Pursuant to the order passed by this Court, learned APP submits that applicants co-operated with the investigation.

sentences.text: It is further pointed out that even charge-sheet is fled on 31/03/2021 in Session Case No. 626/21 before the trial Court.

In this view of the matter, as the charge-sheet is fled and even the prosecution is not now seeking custodial interrogation of the applicants, as all materials have been seized and the applicants have co-operated with the investigation, the present Application deserves to be allowed.
Hence the following order is passed.

2/3  17. aba 2547.19.doc  ORDER i) Application is allowed and the interim order stands confrmed.
ii) In the event of the arrest of the applicants in Crime No. I - 284 of 2019 registered with Bhiwandi Police Station, Thane, applicants shall be released on bail on their furnishing P.R. bond of Rs. 50,000/- each with one or more sureties int eh like amount.
(iii) The applicants shall report to the Investigating Ofcer as and when called for.
(iv) The applicants shall not tamper with the evidence or attempt to infuence or contact the complainant, witnesses or any person concerned with the case.
3. Application is disposed of.

(M.S.KARNIK, J.)
